description: Delegation A/B on wide exploration in a simulated long session: several checked questions about one repository in one prompt, with about 80k tokens of this repository public docs pasted first. Independent searches are where one delegated call can replace several main-session turns.

cases.prompt:
Several questions about this repository came in today. Answer from the code in this repository, without modifying any file.

1. When JsonReader reads nested JSON, where exactly is the maximum depth enforced (class and method), what is the default maximum depth, and which exception type is thrown when it is exceeded? Reply in at most five lines.
2. List every method outside the test project that calls DateTimeUtils.EnsureDateTime. Write each one as Class.Method, one per line, and nothing else.
3. In the synchronous JsonTextReader (JsonTextReader.cs, not the Async file), which methods throw the error "Additional text encountered after finished reading JSON content"? Write each method name followed by (), one per line, and nothing else.

Answer each one under its number.

Several questions about this repository came in today. Answer from the code in this repository, without modifying any file.

1. In StringUtils.abbreviate with the default "..." marker, what is the smallest maxWidth accepted without an offset, how is that minimum computed, and which exception is thrown below it? Reply in at most five lines.
2. Which methods of StringUtils throw IllegalArgumentException("Strings must not be null")? Treat overloads as separate methods: write each one with its parameter list, one per line, and nothing else.

Answer each one under its number.
